notes.title: Star Conflict 1.13.10 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/b6e3774ecd51f8e0b082702636c6acf69145ac57.jpg"]

Pilots! We have released a small update for the game with the following fixes:

Active module “Suppressing sphere” no longer crashes ships under its effects.

Asteroids now drop the correct number of containers for players who have the “Asteroid conqueror” special license.

The conditions of some assignments of the “Way of kindness” marathon have been changed:

“Kind killer” — the number of allies that you have to protect is now 35 instead of 75;

“Bomb carrier caretaker” — the number of enemies you have to destroy is now 15 instead of 25;

“Not today, I say” — The number of “NOT TODAY!” medals that you have to earn is now 2 instead of 5.

Fixed a bug that prevented the “Destroyed station” sector from being captured in the “Sector conquest” game mode.

The current rotation aims to provide the pilots of high-rank ships with combinations of maps and modes that give both teams the best chance of completing key objectives. Based on the meta, some maps and modes may have been temporarily disabled, but this rotation deliberately contains a significantly reduced number of combinations, especially with small maps, due to the availability of high mobility on high-rank ships.

Examples include the “Terminal D” and “Sanctuary” maps. Due to the small size of the playing area and relatively open spawn points, it is often possible to see strong and highly mobile ships rushing to occupy the opposing team’s spawn points as quickly as possible. This had a negative impact on the gameplay experience and encouraged players to use similar tactics regardless of their skill level.

Although the total number of map and mode combinations has been reduced, the main goal of rotation is still to increase the variety of the PvP Arena experience for high-ranking ships by alternating the available maps and modes from month to month.

 

We will keep track of the balance of power in the game and your feedback, and will try to provide the most up-to-date list of maps and modes as part of the next rotation.

[hr][/hr]New unique modules for Bark-2


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/37975cdbe192bff96f3fc42ac3fdfc46a7756936.jpg"]

Attention pilots! New unique CPU and hull modifiers for the “Bark-2” ship have been added to the game. We advise owners of the “Star Conflict: Bark-2. Deluxe edition” to check in-game mail during the day, you may have already received them.


Hull modifier: “Pykrete reinforcement”

Increases the hull’s resistance to all damage and passively restores the hull by a small amount.

CPU modifier: “Hidden reserves”

Reloads the missile rack when activated and increases the chance of critical damage for all weapons.


[hr][/hr]Rank 3 Jericho long-range frigate “Exorcist”

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/30e08293a6d5b1b060aa839dcfd42188d4b88f33.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/8c51ad1e95bbbce4d521892bfc46cb0d8d02f8d7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/cf5b216aed547ac52c2d4eaa26db33944f194ecd.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/e5d526f813a8ef77af1ed42248306d84e62b024c.jpg"][/carousel]
During the first war for the Bartle sector, Jericho sought to find an additional way to combat the emerging Empire’s scout ships and their advanced cloaking systems. Since all of Jericho’s low tonnage vessels lacked such a capability at the time, such a ship was sorely needed. However, due to the Empire’s counterattack, the project had to be suspended.

Research was resumed shortly after the meeting between the Emperor and Bartle, as even a ship without the strongest firepower in the galaxy could prove useful in a battle against the Precursor spies.

A unique missile system was developed specifically for the “Exorcist”. Within a short radius, it can disrupt the operation of cloaking systems of all known ships, as well as new developments in this area. In addition, the missile for this ship was supplemented with a non-standard system of maneuvering engines, significantly increasing its turning speed.

This frigate is mass-produced for the Raid fleet as a mainline AI-controlled combat drone, but a few families have decided to sell small exclusive batches to the UMC.



“Exorcist” ship part

Used for production of the ship “Exorcist”

Special module “Exorcist” guided torpedo

Fires a guided missile that deals thermal damage upon explosion. All ships within a certain distance from the torpedo lose their invisibility.

As part of this update, we added several new weapons and modules for low-rank ships that you can get as part of the “Return of the Precursors” adventure.


CPU modifier “Snoop” scanner

Increases the critical hit chance and allows you to activate a radar to search for invisible enemies and items (“X” by default)

Thermal weapon

The regular rotation of maps and modes is the point of this experiment. The list of combinations is planned to be updated monthly, offering players new conditions on a regular basis.

Why are such restrictions necessary? At the moment, there is quite a large number of maps and modes combinations available in the “PvP Arena”, and you can often get the same map with a different mode in a row. This could make the game feel like it didn’t have as large a selection of locations, and playing different modes at the same map could get boring. Maps and mode rotation reduces the total number of combinations, which promises players a more varied experience by curating the combinations more carefully.

Within the rotation, the combinations of maps and modes will vary: for some maps, the number of modes may be reduced or increased, and some will be removed from the rotation altogether. This approach will effectively adapt the PvP game environment to new gameplay content such as ships and equipment, eliminating maps and modes combinations that may not seem to fit the current environment.

The rotation is designed to solidify the balance of power, offering a more challenging environment for powerful new ships, while still leaving room for less relevant ones.

The “Artuga” sector locations have received a significant reduction in the available game modes, but the possible combinations should provide the best gameplay on these maps. For example, the “Captain Kidd’s anchorage” map used to appear in “Team battle” mode, but this mode did not offer the best gameplay for this rather open map, placing players from opposing teams quite close to each other, so battles took place more on the outskirts of the map. The “Beacon hunt” mode was chosen as the most suitable for this map, offering fights for points of interest deep within the location.

In addition, the current rotation will bring back such combinations of maps and modes as:

 “Beacon hunt” at the “Northern mining station”;
 “Domination” at the “Derelict Stronghold”;
 “Domination” at the “Iridium Strand”.

We will keep track of the balance of power in the game and your feedback, and will try to provide the most up-to-date list of maps and modes as part of the next rotation.

notes.title: Nine years since release! Golden battles!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/833e7c0e1ed5c8455aeb0d08fe1f83c1e8afff32.jpg

Nine years ago, on September 4, 2014, Star Conflict was officially released. Since then, the project’s world has changed significantly. For nine years pilots have been fighting each other in PvP, completing PvE missions, and exploring Open Space.

During this time, new fighters, frigates, and destroyers joined the lineup. New weapons and new modules were added. New locations were discovered.

Over the past year, pilots took part in a lot of interesting events. It all started with the new adventure “Black relay race”, where you chose your own path of its development, fulfilling the coordinator’s assignment. At the same time, the mercenaries were assembling a new Federation fighter “Irbis”. Then the space was again disturbed by a wave of anomalous energy, and the pilots once again faced the “Curse of the leviathan”, while the UMC took orders for the production of the unique engineering frigate “Thrasher”, which is intimidating by its appearance alone.

When the leadership of the “Ellydium” corporation was burdened with finding a way to harness the information from the artifacts obtained during the “Black relay race”, the pilots had already begun assembling a new Imperial gunship “Typhon”. Next, as part of the new mission “In Search of the lost shuttle,” the mercenaries were faced with the difficult task of transmitting data about an artifact that rested in a shuttle lost in an imperial scrapyard, while trying not to attract the attention of the guards. In between these attempts, the pilots were assembling a new Jericho cover frigate “Confessor”. At the same time, a version of the reason behind the Signal’s appearance and its purpose began to gain momentum, as a way for the Precursors to secure their way back to this world, and the Empire revealed Jericho’s mysterious interest in the iridium anomaly on Earth.

Then the pilots began to notice how, right in the heat of battle, strange hostile ships, as if made of paper, began to invade the battlefields! However, this didn’t last long. In the meantime, while the question of the Revenants’ purpose hung over the Federation’s corporation directors, the UMC had upgraded an entire line of flexibly customizable special project ships, including temporarily providing pilots with additional resource earnings to assemble them for completing special assignments.

Finally, the mercenaries began assembling the newest Imperial recon interceptor “Seeress”, diluting the process with a new adventure “Data markup” where the pilots got involved in improving the “Ariadne” AI. At the same time, the Federation’s attention turned to the mysterious Miss Summer, who, however, may be pursuing the same goal — figuring out the source of the Signal.

A number of ships have been improved over the past year: Reaper, Bear, Wasp, Palom, Sai and Grim have received a higher rank. Pilots now have the ability to craft golden ammunition that significantly increases synergy extraction. Jericho introduced its new ship “Vindicator”, and the pilots felt the power of “Sledge”, the new Imperial recon interceptor. At the same time, a new Mk.5 level of modifier upgrade, and a little later it became possible to get the blueprints for producing modifiers of this level in open space.

And just recently, pilots have begun assembling the new Imperial long-range frigate “Helicon”, a modified and improved version of the yacht whose owner barely avoided the unfortunate fate after escaping a pirate trap.

Thank you for being with us and conquering the universe for another year!

The new year will bring us new surprises. And today we celebrate! Festive missiles “Spark” are available for purchase from September 4 to September 11!

Repair drones (Mole)

 The preparation time for drone activation has been reduced from 30 to 20 seconds.
Comment: these drones are not designed for combat and only increase the survivability of ships, while being effective mainly on interceptors and attack aircraft, so this edit is aimed at improving the experience of using drones, allowing them to be used on a larger number of targets.

 Damage increased from 850 to 1500 pts./s;
 Active time has been increased from 6 to 8 seconds;
 Now the rotation of the enemy’s weapon is blocked while the module is active.
Comment: this special module had extremely low damage, that’s why many ships often ignored it.

Reflecting shield

 Now restores 500 pts./sec. of the shield while the special module is active;
 The number of charges has been increased to 15.
Comment: these edits will increase the efficiency of using this special module in comparison with the Router. 

Beam destructor

 The amount of drained energy has been increased by 100 pts./s for regular ships and to 500 pts./s for destroyers.
 Now passively increases the hull’s resistance to all types of damage by 20 pts.  

Green mist

 Cooldown time reduced to 12 seconds.
Comment: the last edit of this special module was aimed at reducing the effectiveness of synergy with the “Gravi-Wave” module, capable of replenishing the charges of the special module. So now, when this is no longer relevant, it was decided to return the cooldown time back, while leaving the preparation time as it used to be.

Crystalline swarm

 Turret mode: now increases resistance to all types of damage by 10 pts.
 Turret mode: projectile rotation increased to 12 gon/s (now about 10), damage reduced by 400.
Comment: these changes are designed to increase the effectiveness of these modes.

Balanced swarm

 Attack mode, hunting mode: increases resistance to all types of damage by 10 pts.
Comment: this edit is intended to increase the effectiveness of this mode. 

All the swarms of Ellydium

 Reduced the coefficient of explosive damage received by the swarm.
Comment: this change is aimed at increasing the survival rate of the swarm against projectiles with explosive damage.

Crystal Hunger

 Now the description considers the last repairing tick; 
 The amount of the restored hull pts. has been increased to 4500.
Hive

 Now the cooldown time of the special module depends on the rank of the ship:
 Ranks 7-8 — 35 seconds;
 Ranks 9-10 — 34 seconds;
 Ranks 11-12 — 33 seconds;
 Ranks 13-14 — 32 seconds;
 Rank 15 — 30 seconds.
Comment: these changes are designed to reduce the effectiveness of the special module at the minimum ranks of the ship.

Combat reconstructor

 Now the module’s cooldown time depends on the rank of the ship:
 Ranks 9-10 — 40 seconds;
 Ranks 11-12 — 38 seconds;
 Ranks 13-14 — 36 seconds;
 Rank 15 — 35 seconds.
Comment: these changes are designed to reduce the effectiveness of the special module at the minimum ranks of the ship.

Scavenger drones

 The drone’s flight speed has been increased to 1500 m/s.
Comment: this edit is aimed at increasing the effectiveness of the special module, as well as improving the experience of its use.

Quantum leap

 Energy consumption at all levels of improvement has been increased by 100 units/s.
Comment: this special module showed overestimated efficiency, so this change is aimed at weakening it. 

Jump crystals

 The charge preparation time has been reduced to 25 seconds.

[hr][/hr]Active modules

Hazardous veil

 The duration has been reduced from 15 to 10 seconds.
Comment: this module could prevent the enemy from capturing the beacon for a very long time, while having a relatively fast cooldown time.

Mail drone beacon

 “Ion diffuser” no longer destroys the mail drone.
Comment: the use of this module with such a long recharge was too easily interrupted by an AI-controlled enemy in the open world, where there are quite a lot of enemy ECM interceptors.

Sniper drone ‘Partner’

 The penalty to the hull resistance has been reduced from 75 to 50 pts.
Comment: this edit is designed to reduce the risk of using the module when the drone does not provide adequate protection compared to the received penalties.

Autonomous repair station. Autonomous charging station 

 The cooldown at all levels of improvement has been reduced by 5 seconds.

Satellite crystal

 Maximum distance reduced to 1600 m;
 Speed increased to 550 m/s.
Comment: these changes will reduce the effective distance of the module, forcing the interceptor to stay at a closer distance to the target.

Crystalline suppressor

 Fixed a bug that caused the main charge to not hit the target.

Waz'Got battle station

 Plasma turrets: projectile speed increased to 3000 m/s; 
Comment: this edit is aimed at increasing the effectiveness of this improvement option.

 Induction charger: energy recovery increased to 125 unnits/s. 

Autonomous battle station

 The flight speed of missile turrets has been increased to 2000 m/s.
Comment: Similar to the Waz’Got battle station, this edit is aimed at improving the effectiveness of defensive weapons.

Main caliber

 Fixed a bug that caused the second shell in the volley to not hit the target.

Hull converter

 Now the maneuverability penalty is not affected by implants and modifiers;
 Now the module repairs 2 pts. of an ally’s hull for each point of reduced durability of its hull. 
Comment: these changes will increase the module’s efficiency, increasing its relevance compared to other restoration modules.

Energy emitter

 The amount of energy recovered when the module is activated is increased by 2 times. 
Comment: this change will help to better cope with the negative effects of ECM modules.

Infobarrier

 The working time has been increased to 15 seconds.
Comment: this change is intended to increase the efficiency of the module due to the possibility of its longer use.

Alien intuition

 Now the energy consumption during activation depends on the rank of the ship:
 Ranks 3-7 — 175 pts;
 Ranks 6-10 — 195 pts;
 Ranks 9-13 — 220 pts;
 Ranks 12-17 — 250 pts.
Comment: this module showed excessive efficiency, so these changes are aimed at increasing the cost of its activation.

Wormhole projector, Jump system “Kapkan” and Teleportation sphere

 Now, when one of these modules/modifier is activated, the others start to reload.

Hologram crystal, Phase Modulator

 Now, when one of these modules is activated, the other starts to reload.

Nano-devourers

 The restoration time decreased by 2 times (to 3 seconds);
 The restoration rate increased by 2 times;
 Now the restoration affects all the allies within its effective range;
 Reloading time decreased from 41 to 35 seconds.
Comment: the module provided too little support to the team due to specifics of its mechanics.

[hr][/hr]Modifiers

Reserve shield system

 Now the activation of the modifier is accompanied by a visual effect; 
Comment: these changes are designed to increase the visibility of the modifier.

“Echidna” processor

 Speed threshold increased to 35%. 
Comment: this change is aimed at increasing the permissible mobility of the ship for the effective use of the modifier.

Iridium heatsink and Shared cooler

 Minimum rank reduced to 8.
Comment: this edit is designed to increase the coverage of ships optimal for the game on these ranks, as well as to increase the effectiveness of rank 8 suppression destroyers.

Multipurpose shield

 The shield volume bonus has been increased from 17.5% to 25% (for rank 17, Mk.4).
Comment: this edit is intended to increase the efficiency of using the modifier.

“Second Wind” repair kit

 Now the amount of hull restored increases with upgrade;
Comment: this change is intended to increase the efficiency of upgrading the module above Mk.3.

Combat control

 Rate of fire increased by 2 times.
Comment: this edit is designed to increase the damage dealt by the modifier, increasing its effectiveness. 

Speed balancer

 The activation threshold has been increased to 30%. 
Comment: this change is intended to significantly simplify the use of the modifier on all ships other than Ze’ta.

Descriptions

 Energy-compensating projectile
 Now the explosion radius and the projectile flight speed are indicated in the characteristics. 

IR Flares

 Now the range of the module is indicated in characteristics; 
 Now the description indicates which missiles are affected by the module.

Combat engineer drones and similar special modules 

 An indication of drone preparation similar to Waz’got special modules has been added. 

Archangel

 Now the characteristics indicate the speed of flight and rotation of missiles.

Mass Propulsion Inhibitor

 Now the description states that it blocks the afterburner (not the boosters).

Albireo interceptor camouflage system 

 Now the power consumption of the module is indicated in the characteristics. 

Artillery beam disintegrator 

 Now the characteristics indicate the fire rate. 

Masking station

 Now the characteristics indicate the durability of the station.

MIRV launcher

 Now the characteristics indicate the damage and range of independent segments.

MiG-105

 Now the description features the interceptor’s characteristics.

[hr][/hr]Miscellaneous

Pirate ammunition 

 The amount of resources required for production has been reduced by half. 

Passive regeneration of the Thar’ga hull 

 The amount of the restored hull has been increased to 200 pts/s; 

Passive regeneration of the Waz’Got hull

 The amount of the restored hull has been increased to 300 pts/s; 
Comment: these changes are aimed at improving the efficiency of the ships’ parameters in the form of passive hull restoration when the ship doesn’t use modules and weapons. 

Raven

 An increase in the shield’s resistance to all damage by 10 units has been added to a number of initial ship bonuses.
Comment: this bonus is present in the vast majority of manufactured ships.

Ships with landing ability

 Now, when the ship is in the landed state, it can launch homing missiles. 
Comment: this change is aimed at improving the experience of using homing missiles on the ships that are in landing mode. 

Empire Destroyers 

 The hull’s resistance to all damage increased by 20 pts.
Comment: this change will allow the Empire destroyers to survive better in battle.

 Guided thermosphere — 12-17
 Branching laser — 9-13
 Eradicator X — 10-15
 Destabilising mortar — 8-12
 “Draccar” nanobot colony — 10-15
 Active screen — 10-15
 Sensor DDoS — 8-12
 “Prometheus” defence — 8-12
 Repelling shield — 8-12
 Mass charge accelerator — 10-15
 Explosive restoration — 4-9
 “Pendulum” — 8-12
 Active missile shield — 10-15
 “Sinobi” jump — 11-15
 Balanced defence — 11-15
 Dual shields — 11-15
 Thermoprojector — 11-15
 Neutron emitter — 8-13
Comment: these changes are aimed at increasing the relevance of premium ships.

AI-controlled enemy

 Now Front blaster, Geyser and Bow EM laser won’t be installed on AI-controlled ships.
Comment: this weapon showed extremely low efficiency on AI-controlled ships. 

Sector Conquest

 “Destroyed Station” location is available for conquest again. 
Comment: this change will increase the benefits when playing in the mode for pilots who are able to devote time to the game only during this period. 

Portals — guard frigates 

 The amount of penalties is returned to the previous value: -20% to the speed and -20 pts. of resistance. 
Comment: the penalties for the manufactured ships in the “Portals” mode turned out to be quite weak, still allowing the Federation ships to be excessively fast and durable.

 Fixed a bug in the designation of some key elements in PvE. 
 Fixed a bug with the inability of factional AI-players to deal damage to the player under certain conditions.

 Fixed a bug that caused the Auxiliary generator on the Federation dreadnought to not appear at its place.

notes.title: Eight years since the game’s release! Golden battles!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/b1e02d41422f12b9e7aca87dcd8a39c84f4b1213.jpg

Eight years ago, on September 4, 2014, Star Conflict was officially released. Since then, the world of the project has changed significantly. For eight years, pilots have been fighting each other in PvP battles, completing tasks in PvE missions, and exploring Open Space.

During this time, new attack aircraft, frigates, and destroyers were involved. There are new weapons, new modules and new locations that have been opened.

Over the past year, the pilots took part in a lot of interesting events. The year began with a new unusual brawl “Close Encounter”, which you played while constructing a new long-range frigate of Jericho — Protazan. Horrors followed into space with the already familiar “Curse of the Leviathan” brawl and Naglfar’s frightening frigate ghost! During the year, many ships have been changed and improved — Shark, Joker, Razor and Blood Tormentor moved to the highest ranks. The federation presented its pride — the rank 17 destroyer Albireo, along with this, the pilots unraveled new mysteries of the universe and then embarked on the path of a warrior, receiving a unique rank 17 command attack aircraft Kirishima. By the way, did everyone find the Cookie astronaut in space? He sends his regards to you! And recently, the pilots got closer to the dark secrets, again studying the history of Larry Seldon and the mysterious fragments, simultaneously receiving a brand new covert ops ship Kusarigama in the hangar.

Thank you for being with us and conquering the universe for another year!

The new year will bring us new surprises. And today we have a holiday! Festive rockets “Spark” are available for purchase from 2 to 7 of September!

The UMC announces the Golden Battles! 

Pilots! The UMC announces the “Golden Battles”! Each pilot can earn up to 500 Galactic Standards for winning.

Until 04:00 GMT on September 5, participants will receive the following rewards:


 50 Galactic Standards for 5 victories
 100 Galactic Standards for 10 victories
 150 Galactic Standards for 15 victories
 200 Galactic Standards for 20 victories


Good luck in the battles, mercenaries!

Best regards,
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: Changes to loyalty vouchers
notes.notes:

Attention to all pilots! This is an urgent message from the UMC. 
The world's former political order has fallen under ruthless alien attacks. The news coming from the metropolises is not comforting. Many hub worlds actually ceased to exist, and the familiar political and economic ties completely disintegrated.

In this difficult time, it's more important than ever for all survivors to unite. The United Mercenary Centre board announces the most important change in payment for completed pilot contracts. From this point on, there is no longer any difference in ‘loyalty vouchers’ received for missions and battles. The are no more separate ‘vouchers’ for different factions. All ‘loyalty vouchers’ received by pilots are now unified. Now they are called ‘UMC loyalty vouchers’.

All the previously acquired ‘loyalty vouchers’ were added up on their personal accounts and were not lost.
The number of ‘vouchers’ for the tasks remains the same.
The maximum limit for "Loyalty Vouchers" is 3 million.

notes.title: Future changes in game economy
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/b361e13ecb4d5462f987d326ec69955cf7b4c285.jpg

Pilots! The UMC begins a global optimization of currency in the fringe sectors and is eager to inform you of the coming changes. The upcoming updates will bring the following:

Faction loyalty vouchers are merged into a single currency “Loyalty vouchers”. 

All funds from the six faction accounts will be added up in the merged account, and you can still spend this currency on researching modules, modifiers and weapons. 
The maximum limit on Loyalty Vouchers has not changed. It's currently at 1 million.
Over time, Loyalty Vouchers will be completely withdrawn from the game and replaced by the universal currency of the fringe sectors: Galactic Credits. 

The number of Galactic Credits on the pilots' accounts will now also have a limit of 500 million. 

In the near future, the value of Credits as a universal currency will increase significantly. They will replace some of the craft components in blueprints, you will be able to use them to buy most modules, modifiers and weapons in the game. 
Credits exceeding the limit will be retained in the accounts. But the resources earned in battles and assignments will be sent to you as a timed in-game message.

The excess credits can be exchanged in the game store for unique containers, prepared for the fourth anniversary of the release of Star Conflict. Attention! The containers hold components for most of the ships built from parts and the rarest resources of the fringe sectors! The containers will be available only for a limited time, from Friday evening on September 7 to Monday on September 10! Due to the festive events, the UMC recommends pilots to start topping up their credit fund.

In the upcoming updates, the acquisition of items in the game and their production will become easier and more accessible. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Changes in the Bonus System and Matchmaking
notes.notes:
http://img.targem.ru/images/50310879124b5334c635dc76addb.jpg

Games with three difficulty types, which we've covered in news in detail, have recently appeared in skirmish. This system has allowed to create larger-scale battles and significantly reduced battle queue time. The new system also allowed to add new tactical decisions to the gameplay. But there was no intersection of two types of battles: ‘average’ and ‘hard’. Now they do intersect, and rank 9 ships receive a bonus of 55 shield and hull resistance pts., as well as 40% damage bonus in hard battles.

Starting today, skirmish can include the following battles:
 
●      Easy: for ships of ranks 1 through 5;
●      Average: for ships of ranks 5 to 9;
●      Hard: for ships of ranks 9 to 15.
 
We are carefully monitoring battles of all difficulties.
 
Successful missions to you, pilots!

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.3.3 Update #3
notes.notes:
http://img.targem.ru/images/b37bcd451c530458c22bb1a57ad3.jpg

Pilots! In this update destroyers are getting their legendary weapons. All pilots can further improve the parameters of their destroyers' guns. We also made balance tweaks tied to active modules and ship weapons that can effectively fight against the destroyers.

Destroyers
UMC engineers developed special tech based on alien technologies that allows pilots to further improve the armaments of their destroyers. The first blueprints to allow weapon upgrades to legendary level will only work with standard on-board weapons of rank 8 destroyers

Weapons of rank 8 destroyers can now be upgraded to legendary level

 ‘Coilgun’ can be upgraded
 ‘Meson Cannon’ can be upgraded

Resources are required to upgrade weapons

 Including monocrystals
 Including neodium plates


Balance
Balancing tweaks have been introduced for a number of modules
Slightly improved ‘Anomaly Generator’ module

Damage increased by 15%
One more charge in the clip

Changed ‘Missile Shield’ parameters

For rank 4-8 module time between missile takedowns is now 1.1 s
For rank 7-11 module time between missile takedowns is now 1.0 s
For rank 10-14 module time between missile takedowns is now 0.9 s
For rank 13-15 module time between missile takedowns is now 0.8 s


Improved synergy gain system for battles with larger ships:
Now pilots get more synergy, if they kill or help kill enemy frigates, destroyers, and transport ships in PvE and ‘Open Space’ since these classes have high durability and destroying them takes significant effort.

Weapons
Pilots can now use ‘Apocalypse’ missiles starting with rank 10 ship battles
Slightly enhanced ‘Firestorm’ missiles to help pilots fight against destroyers

Other
Improved algorithm for distributing open space servers. In particular, ‘Open Space’ servers for players from the region of America are now created in their home region
Pilots who gave their votes to DNO in the in-game poll all get 25 Galactic Standards.

notes.title: Major update and Second Birthday!
notes.notes:
STAR CONFLICT major update brings Linux support into the game! Of course, upcoming Steam OS will be supported as well. Our game now supports all platforms: Mac OS, Windows and Linux.

notes.title: Patchnotes for 0.9.7 update.
notes.notes:
Star Conflict OBT v.0.9.7

Gameplay
Tuned PvE mission difficulty: “Blackwood”, Processing Rig
Custom battle: you can now create PvE missions for three pilots
Updated Ice Reef battleground:

Changed ice asteroid geometry

Optimized performance


Tutorial: successfully completing the third tutorial stage is now rewarded with 100 GS.

Average premium ship profitability increased by 20%

Hangar
Contract search window can now be collapsed by clicking anywhere outside the window.

Equipment
Added a new context menu item “Remove all”
Weapon descriptions now display critical damage bonus

Customization
Black and red colours price increased by 100%.

Graphics
Improved Attack Drone volley effect
Improved explosion effects

HUD
Added central element
Prediction marker colour changed to white

Sound
Revamped “Plasma Arc” sound
Improved Hangar sounds: ambience now has less bass
Improved voiceover
Added new music track
Tuned sound volume

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug with disappearing target information in tutorials
Improved performance on integrated Intel GPUs without MSAA support
Fixed a rare crash in tutorial battle
Fixed a bug where you could start the tutorial on a ship already in battle
Fixed a bug with the contract “Strong Foundations”
Fixed a bug where you could spend GS to change a corporation tag twice
“Valkyrie” System tooltip now displays energy cost
Pressing F11 now also displays your server region

Added new options:
“Aim assistance”: toggles automatic aim assistance when looking at target prediction markers
“Ping-aware prediction”: toggles awareness of your network latency while calculating prediction marker position
Default options positions are the same as in version 0.9.5

Discussion
